author: Tpak
body:
I have been playing a lot of Avicus recentley, and, overall I have enjoyed it so far. Even so far as buying myself Gold. But, I came across a minor detail that really bugs me. At night time 7:00-10:00pm. I have noticed that I get a lot of lag/ping. I do live in England and I am fairly certain that the servers are hosted in North America. But, it only seems to happen at night. Me and my friend (The_Sporty_Gamer) where playing Control The Hill when we noticed that we both were experiencing horrible ping, and it continued. I was even in a Skype Call with him. And the call was completely fine. And, we live in the same area so we both had to handle with this appauling ping. This might be a coincidence, but, it has been really frustrating that I am repeatedly getting killed all because of the dreadful ping. Hopefully you reply with a positive answer.

Kindest Regards
-Billlz
